description:
Wait for the person to choose on the pick page. Long-polls up to 50 seconds and returns as
soon as they click, or status "pending" (call again). Once chosen: their reference with its
screenshot attached and a full build prompt. "dismissed" means none fit: ask what they want.
A pick can be collected for 24 hours.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a choice, 0 to 50.

name: wait_for_pick
title: Wait for the user's pick
